Just Playing and Rating Random Games | Come Check Out BURNOUT PARADISE

Burnout Paradise is a game made by Criterion Games and published under the EA banner. Finding its roots from Burnout 3: Takedown, this game puts you – the driver – in an open world environment… always one stoplight away from some action. With one of the principle features of the game being the fact of how you can total other cars in order to claim “boost,” nitrous oxide, as well as throwing your opponents into the back of the pack. While the graphics are good for a game designed for console, I find some functionality within the game limited. Indeed, the stoplight-race feature is nice, however, I would much prefer an option to instantly start a race from wherever I want through a drop down panel. Smashing into cars is always a good time, so the game has that going for it. But a lack of tutorial screens for some basic modes tends to piss me off in addition to non-skippable scenic sections. The AI seems to be lacking in cleverness, as they tend to all take the same or similar routes in races, therefore a competent player should easily be able to win every single race.

Ultimately, I give this game a 6.9/10 --- and I do designate it worthy of a REPLAY, which will come in several months once I play the game a bit more. So therefore I recommend it to others who are interested in a racer shoot-em-up.

Burnout Paradise is my go to game for listening to podcasts and live streams. It has the perfect blend of adrenaline and no story, which lets me feel the rush of an epic win without distracting me from what I'm listening to.

The driving mechanics are far superior to many modern games (you ever try to drive in Watch Dogs?), and I like earning new cars. Most of the time I just cruise around, though. Paradise City is beautiful.

This is the sort of game you play when you want to zone out and relax. Coupling this with a podcast is a great idea, I'll have to try it out sometime!
